text: EXP-002 primary: under adaptive preferences (consumed-item rule, eta 0.05, FMA-calibrated synthetic catalogue), mean drift under SIM was lower than under RAND: Delta = -0.0355 rad, 95% percentile bootstrap CI [-0.0535, -0.0200], paired t CI [-0.0560, -0.0151], d_z -1.24, n = 10 seeds. Frozen decision: reject H0. The point estimate is smaller than the SESOI (0.05 rad) and the CI spans -SESOI, so practical size is unresolved.
scope: simulation, synthetic catalogue calibrated on FMA, parameters of protocol v1.0
limitations: Withdrawn as assumption-dependent by EXP-003 (C-004); does not replicate on the real catalogue (C-006). Simulated listeners only.

text: EXP-002 secondary drift contrasts vs RAND (adaptive), Holm family of four: POP +0.1630 rad (Holm CI [0.1418, 0.1834]), MMR -0.1162 rad (Holm CI [-0.1377, -0.0983]), EXPLORE -0.0381 rad (Holm CI [-0.0625, -0.0186]); all rejected after Holm.
evidence_path_or_source: results/EXP-002/analysis/analysis.json (drift_family); result ids EXP-002/POP-RAND, MMR-RAND, EXPLORE-RAND
limitations: Holm interval construction fixed in DEC-012 (pending owner ratification). POP has a higher skip rate (0.052 vs 0.006), the pre-stated confounder.

text: Negative control held in EXP-002 and EXP-004: with fixed preferences, drift was exactly 0 for every listener in all 100 fixed-model runs.
limitations: Checks the implementation, not the model.

text: EXP-003 robustness verdict under the frozen rule: the EXP-002 interpretation is withdrawn as assumption-dependent. At eta 0.05 the bounded-confidence rule gives SIM-RAND +0.0069 rad, CI [-0.0130, 0.0303] (practically equivalent, estimated profile) and +0.1883 rad, CI [0.1598, 0.2196] (opposite sign, oracle profile); the exposure rule keeps the EXP-002 sign. Both equivalence readings of DEC-012 agree.
evidence_path_or_source: results/EXP-003/analysis/analysis.json (verdict, cells); result ids EXP-003/bounded/eta=0.05/estimated and /oracle
limitations: Three update rules and three rates only. The sign of SIM-RAND also changes with eta under the consumed and exposure rules (positive at eta 0.01).

text: EXP-003 oracle versus estimated profile check (protocol section 7): the SIM-RAND sign differs between profiles, with both CIs excluding 0, in one cell (bounded rule, eta 0.2: estimated -0.1012 rad, oracle +0.1564 rad); in the other eight rule-rate pairs the point signs agree.
limitations: In that cell the effect depends on the profile estimator.

scope: 1000-track samples of 4,951 FMA test-split tracks (PCA of librosa features), simulated listeners
limitations: One embedding (PCA-16 of librosa statistics); competing explanations listed in the EXP-004 protocol item 3.
